name: disarm-ha
description: Request disarming the HA stack, releasing all watchdogs cluster-wide.

params.name: resource-mode
params.description: Controls how HA managed resources are handled while disarmed. The current state of resources is not affected. 'freeze': new commands and state changes are not applied. 'ignore': resources are removed from HA tracking and can be managed as if they were not HA managed.
